baseline.name: Business Subject Knowledge Foundation Research Baseline v0.1-pre-board-challenge

challenge_scope.purpose: post-seal breadth challenge only; not exact Course Truth mapping

deltas.title: Income elasticity of demand (YED)
deltas.required_change: Add a reusable YED facet covering meaning, formula/sign, normal and inferior products, calculation where required, interpretation, demand/revenue implications, planning implications, assumptions and limitations.

deltas.title: Network analysis / Critical Path Analysis
deltas.required_change: Add a reusable project-planning method covering activities/dependencies, sequencing, network diagrams, duration, critical path, total float, interpretation of delay, resource/time/quality trade-offs, limitations and cross-functional links.

deltas.title: Sales forecasting methods
deltas.required_change: Extend forecasting with historical data, trend, scatter/line of best fit, extrapolation, time series, moving averages where appropriate, qualitative forecasting methods, seasonality, structural change, forecast error and business decision use.

deltas.title: Customer journey, CRM and customer-experience measurement
deltas.required_change: Add explicit customer-journey/CRM facets covering acquisition-to-advocacy, touchpoints, service, retention, CRM data, feedback/reviews, experience/loyalty measures, privacy and marketing-operations interdependence.

deltas.title: Workforce performance metrics
deltas.required_change: Add labour turnover/retention, absenteeism and related workforce-performance measures, with calculations where appropriate, interpretation, context, causal limits and links to recruitment, wellbeing, management, culture and labour cost.

deltas.title: Net Present Value / discounted investment appraisal depth
deltas.required_change: Extend the existing investment-appraisal node with time value of money, discount factors/rates, NPV calculation at suitable Level 3 depth, interpretation, comparison with payback/ARR, sensitivity and non-financial decision factors.

deltas.title: Cost-benefit analysis
deltas.required_change: Add cost-benefit analysis as a decision-method facet covering relevant financial/non-financial impacts, stakeholder distribution, time horizon, monetisation limits, opportunity cost, uncertainty, sensitivity and decision limitations.

deltas.title: International trade, protectionism, FDI and market-entry methods
deltas.required_change: Teach importing/exporting, FDI, licensing, franchising, joint ventures/direct investment, tariffs/quotas/subsidies/trading blocs at appropriate depth, and causal effects on cost, demand, competition, control, supply chains and exchange-rate exposure.

deltas.title: Macroeconomic policy mechanisms
deltas.required_change: Add a bounded government-policy facet covering fiscal/monetary transmission to business, including taxation, government spending, interest rates and exchange-rate policy context without turning the Business foundation into an Economics course.

deltas.title: Shareholder-specific ratios: EPS and ROE
deltas.required_change: Add optional reusable EPS/ROE facets with meaning, calculation, interpretation, limitations and course-selectable depth.

deltas.title: Confidence intervals in marketing data
deltas.required_change: Add a bounded conceptual confidence-interval facet linked to sampling uncertainty and evidence quality; advanced inferential-statistics mathematics remains out of scope unless an exact course requires it.

deltas.title: Contemporary people, supply-chain and ESG facets
deltas.required_change: Make explicit EDIB, employee wellbeing/flexible work, integrated talent development, supply-chain transparency/traceability/responsible sourcing, and ESG measurement/reporting while preserving distinction between disclosure and genuine performance.

deltas.title: AI and disruptive technology
deltas.required_change: No new fundamental node required. Attach current AI/disruptive-technology applications to the existing digital-transformation/capability node and course mappings where specified.

deltas.title: Named frameworks and theorists vary by board
deltas.required_change: Expand the reusable models/framework register only where educationally justified, but map named board-required frameworks separately rather than treating their presence as proof of new factual subject truth.

challenge_conclusion.dominant_result: bounded depth/facet extensions to existing independent subject nodes
challenge_conclusion.next_step: create an unsealed post-challenge candidate version containing accepted deltas, assure it independently, then map exact qualifications to the resulting subject foundation
